The '''Republic Felucia outpost''' was constructed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. It was a base for the Republic during the [[Third battle of Felucia]].
